answer: Relic-lag admission: each agent identity must carry a relic—a timestamped traffic trace from a garden of prior epochs. Admission checks that the trace's inter-arrival rhythm matches a lagoon-shaped burst profile (long quiet, short cluster) unique to organic agents; new identities cannot synthesize the required historical shape without replaying real past traffic. Attackers must acquire and age relics over many epochs, or clone traces already flagged, costing months of latency and trace-capture infrastructure per identity.
